intentComment: STEP 2.1 — deploy InPlaceMigrator + new DOLA/USDC strategies + minter V2, fund migrator allotment (SET DOLA_ALLOTMENT/USDC_ALLOTMENT in the script first or it reverts), wire, revoke V1 / grant V2 mint, record. Broadcast patches YieldStrategyDola/USDC + PhusdStableMinter in mainnet-addresses.ts
storyContext: MigrateSaga2 'InPlaceMigrator route' Script 1 of 3 (Deploy & Freeze). Replaces the abandoned temp-staker 'ys-swap' saga. Steps 2.2 (migrate) and 2.3 (rewire) are DEFERRED / OUT OF SCOPE — consumers of 2.1's handoff only.

broadcast.command: npm run migrate:saga2.1-deploy-preview && node scripts/backup-mainnet-addresses.js && forge script script/MigrateSaga2Deploy.s.sol:MigrateSaga2Deploy --rpc-url $RPC_MAINNET --broadcast --slow --ledger --hd-paths "m/44'/60'/46'/0/0" -vvv && node scripts/patch-mainnet-addresses-saga2-deploy.js

post.effect: copies server/deployments/mainnet-addresses.ts -> mainnet.backup.<timestamp>.ts (runs BEFORE broadcast, after preview)
after broadcast, OVERWRITES YieldStrategyDola/USDC/PhusdStableMinter fields in mainnet-addresses.ts from saga2-deployments.json

notes: ALLOTMENT TRIPWIRE: DOLA_ALLOTMENT and USDC_ALLOTMENT are hardcoded to 0 and run() reverts unless both > 0. The npm entry will revert (intentionally) until the operator edits the script constants.
Preview impersonates OWNER_ADDRESS via vm.startPrank; broadcast signs with a Ledger at m/44'/60'/46'/0/0.
DEPLOYMENTS_JSON = script/migration-inputs/saga2-deployments.json is written only on broadcast (the JS patcher consumes it).
